title: Building Serverless Python Apps Using AWS Chalice
description: Build and deploy a serverless Python app with AWS Chalice, a microframework that ships your code to AWS Lambda and scales it for you.
summary: Shipping a web application usually involves having your code up and running on single or multiple servers. In this model, you end up setting up processes for monitoring, provisioning, and scaling your servers up or down.
takeaways: In this model, you end up setting up processes for monitoring, provisioning, and scaling your servers up or down.

First, create and activate a virtual environment and install Chalice: Language: Shell $ python3 -m venv env $ source env/bin/activate (env) $ pip install chalice == 1 .33.0 Follow our comprehensive guide on the Pipenv packaging tool .
With Serverless Architecture , you don’t manage servers.
